claim_boundary: external frozen decoder coordinate tracking on fresh matched-target order states; not Demian adaptation, self-decoding, routing, learning, or channel causality
fitting_rule: Fit cue6 readout, standardization and temporal tracker only on base-order train32. Apply unchanged objects to paired base-order eval32 and heldout-order eval32. The heldout order has paired histories with exactly equal public evidence targets.
controls: Identity, scalar-scale, proper-orthogonal tracking; analytic latest-cue; conditional train-label shuffle.
decision_rule: Report every seed-by-projection cell. Strong matched-target portability requires orthogonal-track true-label R2 to exceed latest-cue and shuffle in all 12 heldout-order cells at a delay. A failure is a frozen transport failure, not evidence erasure.
